notes: Printed names: 'W. ROCHELLE (NOT OPEN)', 'HOPSON', 'BISHOP', 'W. UNIVERSITY AV.', 'DENNIS', 'ALICE', 'SCIOTO', 'W. DANIELS'; suffix-less names written with 'Street'. Hopson runs north off the top (onto 265) and ends at University (block 3 occupies its line south of University). Bishop is 60 ft north of University and 40 ft south of it, same centreline, and ends at Daniels. Dennis (40 ft) runs from University to Daniels; south of Daniels a 40 ft street leaves at x~1858-2104 (centre ~1981), a ~130 px (~22 ft) jog east of Dennis's line: taken to be Dennis continuing onto sheet 261 (key map prints DENNIS on 261), recorded as 'Dennis Street (south of Daniels)'. Alice and Scioto continue south onto 261/264; Scioto continues north onto 265/266; Rochelle, University and Daniels continue east onto 266/264.
